'''Prison Battle Droids''' were [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as guards in its [[Prison/Legends|detention facilities]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:RtfIO" /> Their design was based on [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica's]] [[CLL-8 binary load lifter]],<ref name="FF30">{{FactFile|30|BIN 1-2|CLL-8 Binary Load Lifter}}</ref> replacing its large hands with weapon systems.<ref name="SWG:RtfIO" />

==History==
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Prison Battle [[Droid/Legends|Droids]] guarded a detention facility in the [[Hidden Rebel Base|hidden Rebel Alliance base]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SWG:RtfIO" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> when the base was discovered by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] agent sent by [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], at least three Prison Battle Droids were destroyed during the Imperial assault on the detention facility.<ref name="SWG:RtfIO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Prison Battle Droids appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RtfIO" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Prison Battle Droid were added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 11|Game Update 11]]," published on [[June 23]], [[2009]], and were present in the game during the [[W:c:swg:Empire Day|Empire Day]] events of 2009,<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 11 Empire Day">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=940830|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 11 Empire Day}}</ref> [[2010]]<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 17 - Empire Day VII / Remembrance Day VII">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1100816|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 17 - Empire Day VII / Remembrance Day VII}}</ref> and [[2011]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Hotfix 19.20">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1219548|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Hotfix 19.20}}</ref> One of the quests of this event sent Imperial players to the Rebel prison on Corellia where they had to kill various Rebel [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player characters]], including three of these droids.<ref name="SWG:RtfIO" />

The game model used for this droid class was first used for various droids, such as [[AK-1A "Hammer"]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] in ''Star Wars Galaxies''{{'}} expansion, [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']].<ref name="SWG:ToOW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan]]''</ref>
